news.title: Nicholas Boggs receives 2026 Truman Capote Award from UI
news.summary_en: Nicholas Boggs, a writer and assistant professor of English and creative writing at Stony Brook University in Stony Brook, New York, has been selected as the 2026 recipient of the Truman Capote Literary Trust Award for Literary Criticism in Memory of Newton Arvin.

news.title: Iowa Writers’ Workshop alumna named finalist for National Book Award
news.summary_en: Poet Brenda Hillman, who earned an MFA from the University of Iowa Writers’ Workshop in 1976, is a 2026 finalist for the prestigious National Book Award.
